calibration.rationale: L2 projection onto a closed convex cone containing the true quantile vector, so the repair provably cannot move the estimate away from it
steps: isotonic (PAV) projection onto the monotone cone

A0.family: LightGBM quantile regression (direct season total), calibrated
A0.grain: position x scoring preset x quantile
A0.missing_values: passed to LightGBM as NaN and handled natively
A0.tuning: none; Q1's predeclared configuration is carried unchanged

calibration.calibration_data: inner chronological split of the training window; the model producing the residuals is fitted on strictly earlier seasons than they are collected on
calibration.coverage_semantics: marginal split-conformal coverage per level over the calibration distribution, not conditional coverage for an individual player
calibration.fitted_parameters: one constant per quantile level per position x scoring
steps: per-level additive shift from out-of-sample residual quantiles
isotonic (PAV) projection onto the monotone cone
